content: Microbenchmark harness patterns: CUTLASS Profiler sweeps M/N/K/tile configs, emits CSV, sorts by flops/s, has best-kernel-for-fixed-shape mode + analytical heuristics to prune search space; config registry maps problem shape -> chosen tile config (autotune lookup table); ROCm hipBench provides axis-based parameter sweeps for HIP kernels; GPU timing via events with warmup + repeats, profiler-based timing for attribution.
